Azerite Surge.name: Azerite Surge
Azerite Surge.description:
When you take the &Reference[Attack] action on your turn, you can replace one of the attacks with a blast of Azerite energy in a 15-foot Cone. Each creature of your choice in the Cone regains 1d10 Hit Points. Each other creature in the Cone makes a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Constitution modifier and your Proficiency Bonus), taking 1d10 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Both the damage and the healing increase by 1d10 when you reach character levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

You can use this ability a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

Built for Success.description: You can add 1d4 to one &Reference[D20 Test] you make, and you can do so after rolling the die but before resolving the effects of the roll. Darkflight.name: Darkflight
Darkflight.description:
As a Bonus Action, you can shape-shift to assume a more bestial appearance. This transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you revert to your normal appearance as a Bonus Action. When you enter your bestial form, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to 2 times your Proficiency Bonus. You can enter this form a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

In your bestial form, you gain the following benefits:

Increased Speed. Your &Reference[Speed] increases by 10 feet.

Reactive Movement.description: You can take a Reaction to move up to 10 feet when a creature ends its turn within 5 feet of you. This reactive movement doesn’t provoke &Reference[Opportunity Attacks].

Draconic Flight.name: Draconic Flight
Draconic Flight.description: When you reach character level 5, you can use your natural form’s wings to fly short distances. As a Bonus Action, you leap into the air and give yourself a Fly Speed equal to your &Reference[Speed] that lasts for 10 minutes. Once you use this trait, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

Emergency Fail-Safe.name: Emergency Fail-Safe
Emergency Fail-Safe.description: When you become &Reference[Bloodied apply=false], you can take a Reaction to spend one Hit Point Die, roll it, and regain a number of Hit Points equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 Hit Point). Once you use this trait, you can’t use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

Eredar Lineage.name: Eredar Lineage
Eredar Lineage.description:
You are part of a lineage related to your ancestors’ embrace of the Light—or of the power of the Burning Legion. This lineage grants you supernatural abilities. Choose a lineage from the Eredar Lineages table: Draenei, Krokul, Lightforged, or Man’ari. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage.

When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose when you select the lineage).

Everlasting.name: Everlasting
Everlasting.description: You don’t gain &Reference[Exhaustion apply=false] levels from dehydration, malnutrition, or suffocation. You don’t need to sleep, and magic can’t put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in an inactive, motionless state, during which you retain consciousness.

Everlasting.name: Everlasting
Everlasting.description: You don’t gain &Reference[Exhaustion apply=false] levels from dehydration, malnutrition, or suffocation.

Fey Ancestry.description: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] condition.

Fury of the Small.name: Fury of the Small
Fury of the Small.description:
When you damage a creature with an attack or a spell and the creature’s size is larger than yours, you can cause the attack or spell to deal extra damage to the creature. The extra damage equals your Proficiency Bonus and is the same damage type as the other damage dealt.

You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest, and you can use it no more than once per turn.

Extra Damage.name: Extra Damage
Extra Damage.condition: When you damage a creature with an attack or spell
Extra Damage.target: Creature's size is larger than yours

Gift of the World Trees.name: Gift of the World Trees
Gift of the World Trees.description: Because of your supernatural connection to the world trees, you have proficiency in the Nature and Suvival skills.

Gliding Wings.name: Gliding Wings
Gliding Wings.description: While you’re in your natural form and don’t have the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition, when you fall, you subtract up to 100 feet from the distance fallen when calculating the fall’s damage, and you can move up to 2 feet horizontally for every 1 foot you descend.

Goring Rush.name: Goring Rush
Goring Rush.description: Immediately after you take the &Reference[Dash] action on your turn and move at least 20 feet, you can make one Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action.

Unarmed Strike.name: Unarmed Strike
Unarmed Strike.condition: When you take the Dash action on your turn and move at least 20 feet

Hammering Horns.name: Hammering Horns
Hammering Horns.description: Immediately after you hit a creature with a melee attack as part of the &Reference[Attack] action on your turn, you can use a Bonus Action to &Reference[shove]{shove} that target with an Unarmed Strike as long as the target is within 5 feet of you. When you shove a target in this way, you can push the target up to 10 feet away instead of 5 feet.

Shove.name: Shove
Shove.condition: When you hit a creature with a melee attack as part of the Attack action on your turn

Haranir Magic.name: Haranir Magic
Haranir Magic.description:
You know the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDruidcraft]{Druidcraft} and @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplThornWhip0]{Thorn Whip} cantrips.

When you reach character level 3, you learn the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplEntangle00]{Entangle} spell. You always have it prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

When you reach character level 5, you also always have the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplSpikeGrowt]{Spike Growth} spell prepared and can cast it the same way.

Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select this species).

Heroic Presence.name: Heroic Presence
Heroic Presence.description: When you cast a spell granted by your Eredar Lineage, if you don’t have &Reference[Heroic Inspiration], you gain it. You can gain Heroic Inspiration in this way once, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

Highmountain Tauren.name: Highmountain Tauren
Highmountain Tauren.description: As an action, you can move up to your &Reference[Speed] without provoking &Reference[Opportunity Attacks] and can move through the spaces of other creatures. Each Medium or smaller creature whose space you enter makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus plus your Strength modifier and has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

Horns.name: Horns
Horns.description: Your horns are powerful natural weapons. When you hit with your Unarmed Strike and deal damage, you can deal Piercing damage equal to 1d6 plus your Strength modifier instead of the normal damage of an Unarmed Strike.

Ingest Minerals.name: Ingest Minerals
Ingest Minerals.description: You don’t gain &Reference[Exhaustion apply=false] levels from malnutrition.

Instinctual Shift.name: Instinctual Shift
Instinctual Shift.description: When you roll Initiative while you have one or more uses of your Darkflight species trait remaining, you can immediately use that trait to shape-shift (no action required).

Sentry's Rest.name: Sentry's Rest
Sentry's Rest.description: You don’t need to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 6 hours if you spend those hours in an inactive, motionless state, during which you retain consciousness.

Specialized Design.name: Specialized Design
Specialized Design.description: You gain proficiency with two tools of your choice.

Taunka.name: Taunka
Taunka.description: Your shaggy hide gives you a +1 bonus to Armor Class and Resistance to Cold damage.

Taunka Lineage.name: Taunka Lineage
Taunka Lineage.description: Your shaggy hide gives you a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

Tauren Lineage.name: Tauren Lineage
Tauren Lineage.description:
You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural qualities. If your lineage grants you an ability that allows a saving throw, the DC equals 8 plus your Strength, Constitution, or Wisdom modifier (choose when you select the lineage) and Proficiency Bonus. Choose one of the following options:

Touch of the Grave.name: Touch of the Grave
Touch of the Grave.description:
When you deal damage to a creature, you can roll a number of d4s equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You deal extra Necrotic damage to the creature equal to the total rolled, and you regain a number of Hit Points equal to the extra damage dealt.

Once you use this benefit, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

Extra Damage.name: Extra Damage
Extra Damage.condition: When you deal damage to a creature

Troll Healing.name: Troll Healing
Troll Healing.description: When you expend Hit Point Dice to regain Hit Points after a Short Rest, you regain Hit Points equal to the maximum roll of the dice plus your Constitution modifier.

Visage.name: Visage
Visage.description: As a &Reference[Magic] action, you can shape-shift into a humanoid form called your visage, or back to your natural form. Your visage has a specific appearance that you choose when you select this species, including your coloration, height and weight, hair length, and sex. Changing shape with this trait doesn’t change your clothing, equipment, or game statistics.

Vulpera Nimbleness.name: Vulpera Nimbleness
Vulpera Nimbleness.description: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you, but you can’t stop in the same space.

Will of the Forsaken.name: Will of the Forsaken
Will of the Forsaken.description: You have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] or &Reference[Frightened apply=false] condition.

Zandalari Troll.name: Zandalari Troll
Zandalari Troll.description: If you roll a 1 on the d20 for a &Reference[D20 Test], you gain &Reference[Heroic Inspiration] at the end of the current turn.
